        y_coords = circles[:, 1]

        # Circle center must be at least radius away from edges

        valid_y = np.all((y_coords >= radii) & (y_coords <= rect_height - radii))

            return 1e12  # Even larger penalty for invalid positions
        
        # Constraint: no overlapping circles - more efficient vectorized approach
        distances = cdist(circles[:, :2], circles[:, :2])

        min_distances = np.min(distances, axis=0)
        
        # Calculate overlap penalties more efficiently using vectorized operations
        overlap_penalty = 0
        # Only consider pairs that might actually overlap based on minimum distances

        # But still strong enough to enforce constraints
